paragraphs.text: Critical authentication bypass in VMware Directory Service, active exploitation of N-able MailAssure SSRF flaw, and compromise of Check Point Security management servers across 22 organizations demand immediate patching and asset validation. The Radware supplier breach exposing customer cloud access keys and Iran-aligned espionage targeting telecommunications extend third-party and monitoring priorities. Control owners must confirm remediation status for all affected products and verify supplier assurance evidence.

Data and privacy owners should assess exposure scope and retention controls for affected systems.
